answer: Release newcomer rewards only after a buyer has renewed a paid contract three times, with a week between renewals. A nectar forecast or a karst river map earns one bonus per contract lineage, even if the seller rotates keys. Count only fees that cleared the refund window and cap the bonus below their sum. An attacker who supplies both sides must lock capital for weeks and lose more in fees than the aliases earn. The contract ID, rather than the seller name, is the ledger entry marked as paid.
